scope: Independent integrity, safe archive structure and native PG15 client full SQL decode only; no database connection, no restore execution or row validation. Archive preserved.
tar_validation: PASS; regular files/directories only; no absolute/traversal/duplicate/link/device entries
extraction_mode: 0700 directories / 0600 files in new private directory
limitations: No isolated PostgreSQL server was started or connected.
This validates logical archive readability, not restored schema/data/ACL/extensions or RLS.
PITR/backup freshness and Render restore readiness require their separate provenance and real restore gates.
